text: On weekdays at Home, if the current time is between 07:20 and 07:40 and a work shift begins at or before 09:00, the user starts commute navigation to Office.
If the user is at Office, daycare pickup begins within 60 minutes, and a rain notification is posted, the user adds an umbrella item to the daycare pickup checklist.
After arriving Home between 19:00 and 20:30 with paused media, the user preference shifts from resuming playback on the phone speaker to resuming playback on the living-room speaker.
During study calendar blocks at Home between 20:00 and 22:00, if study_room illuminanceLux is 180 or lower, the user sets the desk lamp brightness to 65 percent.
If the washing machine reports cycle complete while the user is Away, the user adds laundry transfer to the arrival checklist.
For workouts at Gym, if durationMinutes is 45 or higher, the user starts the post-workout stretching timer.
